d: US President Donald Trump addressed the media on Thursday where he praised Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi and called him a 'good friend.' However, Trump also claimed that India had been doing unfair business with the US and that a trade deal would soon be signed bringing trade to par. On the other hand, Russian President Vladimir Putin also praised India and called out the US for trying to put economic pressure on New Delhi. Putin also offered the Su-57 stealth fighter jet to India and vowed to do more business with New Delhi. So, who is India's true strategic ally and do words mean…
